writing.prompt: It is your first week in junior high. Write a short passage to introduce your new school. Use 'There is / There are' and adjectives (big, new, kind...).
writing.promptCn: 开学第一周,写一段话介绍你的新学校。用 There is / There are 和形容词(big, new, kind…)。

l2: Welcome to my new school, {schoolName}!
There is a {adj} {place}, and there are two playgrounds.
The classrooms are clean and bright.
My teacher {teacher} is kind and friendly.
l3: Welcome to my new school! Its name is {schoolName}.
There is a {adj} {place} near our classroom, and there are two big playgrounds outside.
The classrooms are clean and bright, and there are tall green trees around us.
My teacher {teacher} is kind and patient, and my new classmates are friendly. I really like it here!

writing.prompt: It is your first week in junior high. Write a short passage to introduce yourself and a good friend to your new classmates. Use pronouns (I, my, he/she, his/her, we).
writing.promptCn: 开学第一周,写一段话向新同学介绍你自己和一位好朋友。注意使用代词(I, my, he/she, his/her, we)。
writing.opener: Hello, everyone! Let me introduce myself.

l1: He is {friendTrait}. We are happy together.
l2: Hello, everyone! My name is {myName}.
I am a new student here, and I like {myHobby}.
This is my good friend, {friendName}.
He is very {friendTrait}, and we often help each other.
l3: Hello, everyone! Let me introduce myself. My name is {myName}.
I am a new student in this class, and my hobby is {myHobby}.
I want to introduce my good friend, too. His name is {friendName}.
He is very {friendTrait}, and we always study and play together. We hope to make more friends here!

writing.prompt: Write a short passage about your hobby. Use the simple present tense (I like..., I play..., It makes me...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段话介绍你的爱好。用一般现在时(I like…, I play…, It makes me…)。
writing.opener: I have a hobby that I really love.

l2: My favourite hobby is {hobby}.
I usually do it {when}, {where}.
My friends and I enjoy it together.
It makes me {feel}, and it keeps me healthy.
l3: I have a hobby that I really love. It is {hobby}.
I usually do it {when}, {where}.
My friends and I often practice together, and we help each other.
This hobby makes me {feel}. It also teaches me to keep trying. I hope you like it, too!

writing.prompt: Write a short passage about how your family members support you. Use possessive nouns (my mother's..., my parents'..., my brother's...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段话讲家人对你的爱和支持。用名词所有格(my mother's…, my parents'…, my brother's…)。
writing.opener: My family's love is around me every day.

l2: My family's love is around me every day.
My {member1} {act1}, and it shows my {member1}'s care.
My {member2} {act2}.
In my family's home, I always feel safe and warm.
l3: My family's love is around me every day.
My {member1} {act1}. That is my {member1}'s quiet way of saying 'I love you'.
My {member2} {act2}, and my {member2}'s smile always makes me laugh.
I love my parents' care and my family's warm support. Their love makes me strong.

writing.prompt: Write a short passage about how your family celebrates a festival. Use adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, never).
writing.promptCn: 写一段话讲你家怎么过一个节日。用频度副词(always, usually, often, sometimes, never)。
writing.opener: My family always celebrates the festival together.

l1: I am never sad on that day.
l2: My family always celebrates {festival} together.
We usually eat {food}, and we always visit {who}.
In the evening, we often {activity}.
We are never sad, and everyone is happy.
l3: My family always celebrates {festival} together. It is my favourite time of the year.
Before the day, we usually clean the house. We always eat {food}, and we often visit {who}.
In the evening, we sometimes {activity}, and we never forget to take photos.
We are never sad on this day. Our home is always full of love and fun.

writing.prompt: Write a short passage about what you will do to protect plants and nature. Use the simple future (I will..., I am going to...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段话讲你将怎样保护植物和大自然。用一般将来时(I will…, I am going to…)。
writing.opener: Nature gives us so much, so I am going to protect it.

l2: Nature gives us so much, so I will protect it.
This spring, I am going to {action1} in {place}.
I will also {action2} every day.
Our world will become green and clean.
l3: Nature gives us clean air and green trees, so I am going to protect it.
This spring, I will {action1} in {place}, and I am going to take good care of it.
At home, I will {action2}, and I will not waste paper.
If everyone helps, the trees will grow tall and the air will stay fresh. We will have {hope}.

writing.prompt: Write a short passage to describe what an animal is doing right now. Use the present continuous (It is running..., They are eating...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段话描述一只小动物此刻正在做什么。用现在进行时(It is running…, They are eating…)。
writing.opener: Look! I am watching a lovely animal right now.

l2: Look! I am watching a lovely {animal} right now.
It is in {place}, and it is {action1}.
Now it is {action2}.
It is having a good time, and I am smiling.
l3: Look! I am watching a lovely {animal} in {place} right now.
It is {action1}, and its little eyes are bright.
Now it is {action2}, and it looks very happy and lovely.
The {animal} is having so much fun, and I am learning a lot about animals. I am really enjoying this happy day!

writing.prompt: Write a short story (about 40 words) about a time you felt happy because you helped someone. Use the simple past tense.
writing.promptCn: 写一个约40词的小故事,讲一次你因为帮助别人而感到快乐的经历。用一般过去时。
writing.opener: Last week, something made me really happy.

l2: Last week, I met {who} {place}.
So I {act} to help.
{who} smiled and thanked me.
At that moment, I felt {feel}.
l3: Last week, I saw {who} {place}, and they really needed some help.
Without thinking, I {act} at once.
{who} smiled warmly at me and said thank you many times.
Helping others made me feel {feel}. A small kind act can bring big happiness to both of us.

writing.prompt: Write about a time (about 40 words) when you did not give up. Use indefinite pronouns (something, everyone, nobody...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段约40词,讲一次你没有放弃的经历。用不定代词(something, everyone, nobody…)。
writing.opener: Everyone can do more than they think.

l2: At first, {task} was very hard, and I felt {feel}.
Everyone expected me to give up.
But something inside me said, "Keep going."
Because of {push}, {result}.
l3: When I started {task}, it was so hard that I felt {feel}, and nobody believed in me.
Many times I wanted to stop, but something inside me said, "Never give up."
I remembered {push}, and I tried again and again.
At last, {result}. Now everyone can do great things if they keep trying.

writing.prompt: Write about your favourite food (about 50 words). Use linking verbs (looks, tastes, smells + adjective).
writing.promptCn: 写一段约50词,介绍你最喜欢的食物。用系动词(looks, tastes, smells + 形容词)。
writing.opener: Everyone has a favourite food, and mine is special.

l2: My favourite food is {food}, and {who} makes it for me.
It looks simple but smells {smellAdj}.
When I eat it, it tastes {tasteAdj}.
It always makes me happy.
l3: My favourite food is {food}. Every time {who} cooks it, the whole room smells {smellAdj}.
On the plate, it looks warm and lovely.
The first bite tastes {tasteAdj}, much better than any food in a restaurant.
To me, {food} is not just food; it tastes like home and love, and it always makes me smile.

units.title: Unit 4 The art of having fun

writing.topic: How to have fun and stay healthy
writing.prompt: Give some advice (about 50 words) on how to relax and have fun. Use imperative sentences (Don't..., Take a break, Play...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段约50词的建议,讲如何放松和享受生活。用祈使句(Don't…, Take a break, Play…)。
writing.opener: Life is not only about study and work.

l2: Don't just sit and study all the time.
Take a short break {when}, and go outside.
Try {activity} {place} with {friend}.
Remember: rest well, and you will learn better.
l3: Don't spend every hour on your books, or you will feel tired and unhappy.
When you are tired, take a break {when} and get some fresh air.
Try {activity} {place} with {friend}; laughing together makes you feel great.
Remember: work hard, but play hard, too. A happy mind is a strong mind.

writing.prompt: Describe your hometown (about 60 words). Use comparatives and superlatives (bigger, the most beautiful...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段约60词,描述你的家乡。用比较级和最高级(bigger, the most beautiful…)。
writing.opener: My hometown is a place I love the most.

l1: It is greener than a city.
l2: My hometown is {place}, and {feature} makes it special.
The air here is cleaner and fresher than in a big city.
{season} is the most beautiful season of the year.
I love it because {why}.
l3: My hometown is {place}. Of all the places I know, {feature} is the most beautiful.
The air is cleaner, the water is clearer, and life is quieter and slower than in a busy city.
{season} is the loveliest time of the year, when everything looks its best.
No city in the world is as dear to me as my hometown, because {why}. I hope to live there again one day.

writing.prompt: Recommend a place you visited (about 60 words). Use 'as ... as' (as beautiful as, as cool as...).
writing.promptCn: 写一段约60词,推荐一个你去过的地方。用 as … as(as beautiful as, as cool as…)。
writing.opener: Last holiday, I went on a wonderful trip.

l1: It was as {adj1} as a painting.
The air was as {adj2} as autumn.
l2: Last holiday, I visited {place} with my family.
The view was as {adj1} as a dream.
We spent the day {activity}, and it was great fun.
Even in summer, the air felt as {adj2} as autumn.
l3: Last holiday, my family and I went to {place}, and I will never forget it.
The whole place was as {adj1} as a painting, and I could not stop taking photos.
We spent hours {activity}; it was not as tiring as I thought, and I enjoyed every minute.
If you want a trip as {adj2} and happy as mine, go and see {place} yourself!
